task.text: 1\. Follow the same approach used for HPI, but put the difference only in approved lines such as travel and consumable supplies. 2. Since she did not provide a contract ID, use 286R; it is confusing because the funding comes from one school while the program is hosted at another location. 3. The NCA contract ID is the same situation—it was not provided. 4. Use the numbers she supplied when I asked, although I don't think she knows the correct answer. 5. To keep everything consistent, apply the dates she gave us to all of the date fields. She has been especially difficult to work with and still hasn't supplied the information we need for our schedules, so hopefully the documents won't get kicked back again.
